summary: Verified the AuthScreen redesign (login) end-to-end plus backend regression. Backend: 42/42 PASSED via pytest-xdist on /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py + test_theme_defaults.py (auth login/me/forgot/reset, register-coach, register-parent valid+invalid invite, PADRE 403 on PUT /config and other writes, seed, /config, /club/invite, teams/matches/standings/jornada-dates/players CRUD, upload/download, AI scan). Frontend: Expo web preview loads the new login WITHOUT bundler errors; auth-card is visible, futbase-logo renders, fixed brand title 'Futbase 7-11' is shown (no club-name caching), subtitle 'Iniciar sesión', gold 'Entrar' Pressable (auth-submit) works. Full login flow with coach@test.com / test123 succeeds and the main app renders with nav-tab-matches (Partidos/Tabla/Plantilla/Rankings/Míster) tab bar.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should migrate in affected components (likely tab/header). Reference: console output on initial load.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate deprecated RN style props: replace 'shadow*' with 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' with 'style.pointerEvents' in components that trigger the warnings on root load.

(Carryover) Return 404 on cross-club PUT /{teams,matches,players}/{id} instead of 200+null; rate-limit /auth/forgot-password BEFORE insert; magic-byte sniff on /api/upload; split server.py into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/screens/AuthScreen.tsx: brand title is hard-coded to 'Futbase 7-11' (line 74) — no club-name cache leaks into the login header, as required by the problem statement.
testIDs are in place: futbase-logo, auth-card, auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit, go-coach, go-parent, go-forgot, go-back-login, auth-nombre, auth-club-name, auth-invite-code.
LinearGradient CTA uses correct gold palette (#F3D778 → #D9A72C → #A9741A); dark card (#343638) and black root (#0A0A0B) match the mockup.
KeyboardAwareScrollView + SafeAreaInsets correctly handle keyboard on mobile; email input uses autoCapitalize='none' and keyboardType='email-address'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested login flow (bundle loads, UI matches mockup, coach login navigates to tabs)

seed_data_creation: Session-scoped transient coaches/parents created by conftest fixtures (parent_<uuid>@test.com) via register-coach / register-parent. coach@test.com/test123 reused via login. No prod data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login redesign verified. Use testIDs: auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit to log in. After login, the tab bar exposes nav-tab-matches. Backend EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://futbase-7-11-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com. Full backend suite runs in ~17s with `pytest backend/tests/test_backend.py backend/tests/test_theme_defaults.py -n auto`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested flows (login redesign render + e2e coach login, backend coach/parent register-login-invite-config regression) are green.
